sources.title: danielsanski/poolformer-baseline · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Overview A small Poolformer implementation for Matching, packaged with an explicit configuration and an initialization checkpoint. The xlarge variant is a reproducible starting point, not a trained model release.

sources.title: PoolFormer · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: PoolFormer has a hierarchical architecture, where instead of Attention, a simple Average Pooling layer is present. All checkpoints of the model can be found on the hub. One can use PoolFormerImageProcessor to prepare images for the model. As most models, PoolFormer comes in different sizes, the details of which can be found in the table below.
